title_en: Vessel USN Monitoring System for Safety Shipping Service
title_ko: 선박 안전운항을 위한 선박 유비쿼터스 센서네트워크 모니터링 시스템
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A vessel USN monitoring system for a safety shipping service is provided to make an operator who does not know professional knowledge about a ship reduce ship safety accidents through warning due to a dangerous element of a ship. CONSTITUTION: A vessel USN monitoring system for a safety shipping service includes sensor nodes, a sensor network configuration method, a monitoring system, a database and a user monitoring system. The sensor nodes measure all kinds of situations and states. The sensor network configuration method includes the sensor nodes. The monitoring system manages the measured information.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 유비쿼터스 센서네트워크(Ubiquitous Sensor Network, 이하 USN)를 이용한 선박관리 기술에 관한 것으로, 각종 상황 및 상태를 측정하는 센서노드들과 상기 센서노드들을 포함하는 센서네트워크 망구성 방식과, 상기 측정된 정보를 관리하는 모니터링 시스템과, 상기 모니터링 시스템으로의 송수신 정보를 구성하는 데이터관리(데이터베이스), 상기 데이터베이스와 상황정보를 송수신하는 사용자 모니터링시스템으로 구성된 선박 관리 시스템 상에서 선박 관리 기술에 관한 것으로, 선박의 안전과 관련된 주요위치(엔진, 선두, 프로펠러, 갑판 등)로부터 센서노드의 위치정보, 상태정보 및 주변 환경 정보들을 측정하며, 상기 센서노드들로부터 측정된 정보들을 모니터링 시스템으로 전송하고, 상기 모니터링 시스템에 수신된 정보들을 토대로 선박의 안전과 관련된 데이터를 실시간 모니터링 및 원격 관리하며, 상기 검토 결과 안전 기준치 이상의 데이터 또는 현장 조치가 필요한 사항이 감지되면 이상감지 정보를 사용자 및 관리자 단말기로 이상감지 결과를 전송하며, 상기 사용자 및 관리자 단말기에서 전송된 조치사항 결과 정보를 모니터링 시스템에서 받아 선박의 정비 이력 관리를 특징으로 한다.

title_en: System and method for trust parameters in vehicle warning messages
abstract_en: An application server in a cellular network receives incident information and determines a trust value associated with the incident information using one or more trust parameters. The application server generates a warning message including the the trust value and the one or more trust parameters. The warning message is broadcast to user equipment in vehicles in an area of relevance. The user equipment in the vehicles in the area of relevance receives the warning message and may re-evaluate the trust value in the warning message based on additional trust parameters or information. The user equipment may determine to perform one or more actions based on the trust value, such as providing a warning to a driver or performing a braking operation.

title_en: Satellite communication-based offshore emergency information transmission method and system
abstract_en: The application provides a satellite communication-based offshore emergency information transmission method and system. The method comprises the steps of constructing a temporary special satellite communication link, conducting parameter optimization on the temporary special satellite communication link to obtain an optimized communication link, conducting three-dimensional reconstruction on site environment, analyzing severity description of illness state, predicting illness state development to generate illness state prediction results, conducting optimization processing on distribution strategies of special medical materials by considering factors of weather change and ocean current direction to obtain an optimal distribution path plan, conducting pattern recognition and trend prediction to generate potential risk early warning to form updated medical requirements, and reevaluating and optimizing the optimal distribution path plan to generate the updated optimal distribution path plan. The technical scheme provided by the application improves the efficiency and accuracy of the response of the offshore emergency, and ensures that medical materials can be timely and accurately delivered to the emergency site.

title_en: New nuclear reactor building
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To minimize damage to a nuclear reactor building due to an earthquake or a seismic sea wave, prevent a nuclear accident by sprinkling water over a nuclear reactor from the upper part of the building to cool the reactor, and avoid diffusion of radioactive matter to the outside.SOLUTION: A nuclear reactor building has a shape of a cylinder and is built under the ground. The upper part of the building has a cooling-water storage pool and the lower part of the building has an area for a reactor container to be installed. The cooling-water storage pool is integrated with the area for a reactor container. As a result, damage due to an earthquake or a seismic sea wave is minimized. Even when a power source or a facility of the building is out of order caused by damage due to an accident or other incidents, providing the cooling-water storage pool in the upper part of the nuclear reactor building enables the supply of cooling water by utilizing the difference in height between the cooling-water storage pool of the upper part of the building and the reactor container of the lower part of the building.

title_en: Systems and methods for GPS-based emergency incident management with dynamic boundary control and automated resource tracking
abstract_en: A computer-implemented emergency incident management system includes a situation management module that generates digital incident situations with unique identifiers and assigns administrative control to situation owners and administrators. A geofencing module establishes GPS-based geofences comprising adjustable center points and adjustable radii defining physical incident areas that may be adjusted in real-time as incidents evolve. An access control module validates credentials at situation-level, agency-level, team-level, and individual-level before granting access to responder users. A resource tracking module receives GPS location data from responder computing devices, compares GPS coordinates to geofence boundaries, and selectively displays GPS locations on map interfaces when responders are within geofence boundaries while suppressing display when outside. A communication module automatically generates general communication channels and creates encrypted communication channels based on security classification requirements. The system generates comprehensive audit trails and formats incident data for FEMA compliance and reimbursement documentation.

title_en: Voice emergency information notification device
abstract_en: To provide a voice emergency information notification device that can quickly detect a failure in a speaker of a slave station of a disaster prevention administrative radio.SOLUTION: A voice emergency information notification device 1 includes: a wireless receiver 10 that receives a wireless signal and outputs a variable audio signal gain to a digital amplifier 15 during an audio output period; and impedance detection means (current detector 22) that detects the input impedance of a speaker 18. When a speaker is newly installed or replaced, a CPU 20 measures an initial value of the input impedance, and sets the normal range using the value as a reference value. After that, during an audio non-output period, the input impedance of the speaker is measured as a monitoring value, it is determined whether the monitoring value exists in the normal range. When it is determined that the monitoring value does not exist in the normal range, alarm means (alarm lamp 40, alarm buzzer 41) broadcasts the alarm that the speaker is out of order.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

abstract_en: The present invention relates to a resident public information transmitting service system using WiFi and a beacon and, more specifically, to a resident public information transmitting service system using WiFi and a beacon capable of providing a free WiFi service, a crime protection service, a fire prevention service, a children care service, a safety home returning service, and the like and simple advertisements by making local residents spontaneously join to an individual local WiFi community zone by providing the crime protection service, the fire prevention service, the children care service, the safety home returning service, and the like necessary for lives of the local residents to improve an existing resident public information transmitting service system. The existing resident public information transmitting service system using WiFi and a beacon annoyed users by providing indiscriminate advertisements and useless information even though a WiFi-based free service platform using the beacon and an online-to-online (OTO) technology. Thus, the users tended to select a paid wireless communication network data service. The resident public information transmitting service system provides the crime protection service, the fire prevention service, and the missing child searching service necessary for lives by including: the beacon; a mobile terminal enabling specific report such as an emergency report within a short time by using a location sharing and reporting widget or being strongly shaken; a server receiving corresponding information from the beacon and the mobile terminal, storing the received information, and statically managing client management items, client suggested items, membership history management, a mobile application spread, and an application usage frequency per client and store. Accordingly, the resident public information transmitting service system using the WiFi and the beacon is capable of presenting an alternative for preventing the clients from being annoyed by excessive marketing messages and stopping a communication with the resident public information transmitting service system.
